content.short: Hyperliquid is a high-performance perpetual DEX built on its own L1 featuring a native on-chain order book.
content.description: Hyperliquid is a leading decentralized perpetual exchange built on its own dedicated Layer 1 blockchain, optimized for high-speed financial operations. The platform features an on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) that delivers a professional trading experience with sub-second execution and deep liquidity. By operating on its own chain, Hyperliquid eliminates the constraints of general-purpose networks, allowing for a highly specialized infrastructure. In addition to perpetuals, it supports spot trading and native asset management, all secured by a decentralized validator set.
content.meta: Hyperliquid provides a high-performance perpetual DEX and Layer 1 blockchain. Discover Hyperliquid and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
